modules.name: Contacts and leads
notes: Directory/detail/timeline/update/recalculate responses include deal-derived facts and require deals.view in addition to contact permissions.
Leads use contact permissions. Deleting a contact/lead can unlink retained deals and additionally requires deals.edit.
Custom personal sending requires contacts.manage. A native template picker or template_id additionally requires templates.view.
Writing raw contact tags additionally requires tags.edit; validating a non-null owner reference requires managers.view.

modules.name: Deals and deal activities
notes: Full deal reads and mutation acknowledgements require deals.view, contacts.view, companies.view and managers.view for linked contact/company/owner labels.
Creating or changing a deal stage also requires pipelines.view. managers.view does not grant the global user roster or security operations.

modules.name: Contact lists
notes: Membership reads require contacts.view and lists.view. Assignment and removal require contacts.edit and lists.edit.
Full catalog DTO counts require contacts.view; deleting a list removes memberships and requires contacts.edit.

modules.name: Contact tags
notes: Assignment reads require contacts.view and tags.view. Assignment and removal require contacts.edit and tags.edit.
Full catalog DTO counts require contacts.view; renaming/removing linked tag names requires contacts.edit.

modules.name: Contact segments
notes: Reading segment contact results also requires contacts.view.

modules.name: CRM campaigns
notes: Recipient and delivery histories also require contacts.view. Sending, scheduling, pausing and resuming require campaigns.manage.
Native campaigns and sequence delivery engines must use their source APIs; CRM campaign aliases cannot expose them.
Template origin references require templates.view. Explicit member-directory/member-segment audiences remain global-admin-only across authoring, preview, sending and captured receipt history.

modules.name: Email sequences
notes: Subscriber, test and trigger histories also require contacts.view. Activation, enrollment, removal, event capture and test sending require sequences.manage.

Explicit member-directory/member-segment audiences remain global-admin-only across authoring, enrollment and captured receipt history. Consented signup/purchase event capture alone is a separate concept.
Generic PUT status assertions also require sequences.manage because they invoke engine control. Ordinary authoring patches must omit unchanged status; expected_version still protects the save.

modules.name: Companies
notes: Full company DTOs contain contact/deal counts and value and require contacts.view plus deals.view. Deleting a company can unlink retained deals and additionally requires deals.edit.

modules.name: Contact imports
notes: Import execution requires imports.manage and contacts.view. The actual plan separately requires contacts.create for new records, contacts.edit for updates, tags.edit for tag changes and lists.edit for memberships.
Combined legacy /import must authorize all effects before saving a job; a denied operation must not leave a partial job/audit.

modules.name: Contact exports
notes: Generating or downloading contact records requires exports.manage and contacts.view. Saved list/tag filter references additionally require lists.view/tags.view, including downloads.

modules.name: CRM settings
notes: Reading and changing CRM settings requires settings.manage.

modules.name: CRM operational logs
notes: Clearing CRM operational logs requires logs.manage.

modules.name: CRM managers and roles
notes: Changing security roles or assignments and reading the general user picker additionally requires a global administrator. CRM permissions never grant that global identity.
The default role is not assigned automatically. Current default and assigned roles cannot be deleted.
